topic: Pay Off Credit Cards or Other High Interest Debt
subtopic: Pay Off Credit Cards or Other High Interest Debt
source_evidence: Virtually no investment will give you returns to match an 18% interest rate on your credit card.
question: Misconception: It’s usually better to keep high-interest credit card debt and invest the money instead, because investments can earn more.
answer: The source advises eliminating credit card debt before investing: it says virtually no investment will match an 18% credit card interest rate. It also recommends paying down other high-interest debt, about 8% or above, when it offers no tax advantages.
